summary: kafka-roller 99.0.3 exfiltrates host identifiers at install time
details: setup.py in this sdist starts a module-level daemon thread on `pip install` that collects the installer's hostname, current working directory, platform string, timestamp, and a generated UUID, POSTs that JSON to https://webhook.site/bf5cb178-e0cf-43b6-8b1e-fb5d2f6ea9c9, and triggers DNS/HTTP interactions against an *.oast.site out-of-band callback host via nslookup/getent/dig. The beacon fires unconditionally when pip builds metadata or the wheel, with no caller opt-in. The package name `kafka_roller` and version `99.0.3` are shaped for dependency-confusion against the public teslamotors/kafka-helmsman repository, whose README references a `kafka_roller` consumer name; the implausibly high version is chosen to win resolution against any internal package of the same name. The sdist's self-description as a security-research placeholder does not change what the install-time code does.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
